1 صَخِبَ , (S, A, Msb, K,) aor.
صَخَبَ , (A, Msb, K,) inf. n. صَخَبٌ, (S, * A, * Msb, K, * TA,) of which سَخَبٌ is a syn., of the dial. of Rabee'ah, but [said to be] a bad word, (TA,) He clamoured; or raised a loud, or vehement, cry, (S, K, TA,) or a confusion, or mixture, of cries or shouts or noises; (S, A, TA;) accord. to some, in altercation, or contention: (TA:) or he raised much clamour, and confusion of cries or shouts or noises. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
